envelope.description: runShellBytes with stdin, isolation and independent limits

body.title: runShellBytes with stdin, isolation and independent limits
body.summary: Add runShellBytes to shell-helper.ts: stdin delivery, isolate (fresh env from PATH only, GIT_* isolation, git-reader's GIT_READ_ARGS), independent stdoutLimit and stderrLimit with stderrOverflow, binary-safe stdout. Existing runShell behaviour is unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: stdin bytes reach the child and a binary stdout round-trips unchanged
With isolate set the child sees an environment built from PATH only plus the git read arguments, not the caller's GIT_* variables
stdoutLimit and stderrLimit apply independently and an overflowing stderr sets stderrOverflow without cutting stdout
runShell callers and their tests are unchanged

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/__tests__/shell-helper-bytes.test.ts: runShellBytes returns stdout bytes unchanged, delivers stdin and applies the isolate environment
src/daemon/tools/__tests__/shell-helper-bytes.test.ts: runShellBytes reports a stdin write error and a cancellation and leaves runShell unchanged
src/daemon/tools/__tests__/shell-helper-bytes.test.ts: independently lowered stdout and stderr limits behave as the corpus reader's limits do and stderr overflow sets stderrOverflow
